Method of Attack: Abuse of configuration files (.yarnrc and .npmrc) to execute malicious binaries
Hiding malicious code using invisible Unicode characters
Impacted Systems: Projects using npm and yarn package managers
Attack Vector: Manipulation of yarnPath in .yarnrc or equivalent in .npmrc to execute malicious binaries
Use of hidden Unicode characters to conceal malicious logic in source code
Indicators of Compromise: Presence of .yarnrc or .npmrc files with suspicious configurations (e.g., yarnPath pointing to a binary)
Hidden files or binaries with invisible characters in their names
Unexpected behavior during yarn install or npm install
